description.value: JX Campground and Surf Shop sits on the Tofino-Ucluelet Highway on the west coast of Vancouver Island, offering tent, van, and RV camping alongside surf lessons and equipment rentals. The property hosts three rotating food vendors — South American empanadas, a taco and falafel truck, and Neapolitan-style pizza — making it an unusually well-fed stop on this remote stretch of coast. T-Bird E-bike Rentals also operates on-site, giving visitors a way to explore the surrounding Yuułuʔiłʔatḥ First Nation territory.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is JX Campground and Surf Shop at 2695 Tofino-Ucluelet Hwy — a campground and surf rental operation with multiple on-site food vendors, not a convenience or grocery store as OSM tags suggest. Potable water is explicitly listed as an included campground amenity ('Potable water available (on property)'), and hot food is confirmed via three named food vendors. The OSM name 'JX Surf Shop Store' differs from the website name 'JX Campground and Surf Shop', and the shop=convenience tag appears to be a misclassification for what is primarily a campground and outdoor recreation business.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'JX Surf Shop Store' but the website consistently uses 'JX Campground and Surf Shop'.
Category mismatch: OSM tagged shop=convenience (Groceries) but the business is a campground and surf rental operation with no confirmed retail grocery items.
Seasonal operation: OSM description tag states 'Open Apr-Nov'; website confirms a seasonal spring reopening, so this listing is not year-round.
Phone number and address absent from OSM; both values taken from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible campground and surf shop on a major cycling corridor (Tofino-Ucluelet Hwy) with food vendors, potable water, and e-bike rentals — directly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: T-Bird E-bike Rentals operates on-site. Business is seasonal (approx. April to November per OSM tag and website seasonal reopening references). WiFi is listed as an included campground amenity.

provenance.category_correction_reason: Website describes a campground and surf rental shop with food trucks, not a grocery or convenience store. No grocery or convenience retail items are mentioned anywhere on the website. A category such as Camping or Outdoor Recreation would be more accurate.
